item.title: Ukraine strikes Iranian arms ship on Caspian Sea, Iran threatens retaliation
item.description: Ukraine on Saturday struck an Iranian cargo vessel in the Caspian Sea, marking the first direct military confrontation between Kyiv and Tehran since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion. item.title: Chip stocks sink after Chinese rival CXMT surges 466% in Shanghai debut
item.description: Chinese chipmaker CXMT soared 466% in its Shanghai stock market debut, becoming the most valuable listed company in mainland China and sending shares of rival chip makers sharply lower.

item.title: Chinese AI model Kimi K3 ignites panic in Silicon Valley, reigniting open vs. closed debate
item.description: Silicon Valley has spent much of the past week on high alert after the arrival of Kimi K3, a Chinese AI model from Moonshot AI that allegedly outperforms some of the best U.S. systems at a fraction of the cost.
